video_title: Steve Novak and Thanasis Antetokounmpo debate the GOAT from THREE.

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry and Damian Lillard's impact on three-point shooting
quotes.excerpt: the conversation went from we can't win shooting threes to he was winning shooting threes

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: Give me a current top five first.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Novak
text_blocks.text: Shooters. I mean, Steph is right there, he's on top. All-time and current. Just for what you said, the way he changed the game, the way he turned the conversation from we can't win shooting threes to he was winning shooting threes. And the whole world said, all right, we subscribe to that. And the analytics said, oh, and by the way, we can back that up. So to me, it's hands down.

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson's role as a catch-and-shoot king
quotes.excerpt: Klay was the literal opposite. He was the catch-and-shoot version of Steph
quotes.quote: The current number two, in my opinion, and he's benefited from Steph, is Klay. The fact that he's a different player than Steph, he's not a point guard, he's not out there averaging ten assists, but he is a catch-and-shoot king. You look at James Harden, the way he played, it was like he was a hundred million dribbles. I'm not saying good or bad, I'm just saying Klay was the literal opposite. He was the catch-and-shoot version of Steph and they played together, that's why they won championships.

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: Brook Lopez's evolution into a high-volume three-point shooter
quotes.excerpt: to see not only was he a guy who didn't shoot threes, who now does stroke it
quotes.quote: Our guy Brook Lopez, to your point, I'm putting the Bucks back in it. To see not only was he a guy who didn't shoot threes, who now does stroke it from three, but not just from three, where he shoots it from, and the fact that the guy who's guarding him is the other team's five-man. That changes everything. He's not even shooting the regular three, he's shooting it from five to seven feet further away.

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard's ability to hit deep fadeaway shots
quotes.excerpt: the fact that he can hit a fadeaway from 40 feet away on multiple occasions
quotes.quote: When you see guys like Damian Lillard, the fact that he can hit a fadeaway from 40 feet away on multiple occasions. I don't even care what his percentage is, you know he's got the gene. Those are the guys I like watching shoot that thing because I'm looking going, what is it about how he shoots it?

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: Ray Allen and Dirk Nowitzki's unique shooting styles
quotes.excerpt: he was a jump shooter, but he was shooting the three unapologetic
quotes.quote: For me, Ray Allen. I watched the Bucks growing up. He was a jump shooter, but he was shooting the three unapologetic and he was doing it in stretches where you're like, I never seen this. And Dirk the same, a seven-footer.

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: Reggie Miller's movement and physicality in playoff series
quotes.excerpt: the battles he went through, the physicality he played with
quotes.quote: I think back to just all the special playoff series with Reggie Miller. The way he moved, the battles he went through, the physicality he played with. He shot it in an era where they were trying to kill him. They were trying to put a bow on his chin every time he came through the paint and he was just talking trash and he was doing it.

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry's multifaceted role beyond just being a shooter
quotes.excerpt: some guys like Steph Curry who have so much more to do
quotes.quote: Some guys like Steph Curry who have so much more to do. They're running point, they got to assist, they got to establish the offense, they got to play big minutes, they got to make big shots early and late. Other guys are just shooting it and some guys are that superstar, all-star level that I think people don't realize. He's not just shooting.

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of mid-range and post games for three-point success
quotes.excerpt: it's the question how do they get their threes
quotes.quote: It's the question how do they get their threes, not how many can you get up. The answer always I find tends to come back to they got a good post game, they got a great mid-range game, they got great shooters, they got playmakers. It's never just one thing.

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: The necessity of putting in the work to become a shooter
quotes.excerpt: the only way you can end the moment in a big moment in a game
quotes.quote: To me, you have to spend the time shooting the shots because the only way you can end the moment in a big moment in a game, feel like you're supposed to be shooting a shot, is if you've put the reps in and you've put the work in. Regardless of how jacked up your form is or not, if you've put the work in and if you've shot enough reps that you feel like when you're on the court, it's your shot, it doesn't matter how your form looks.
